tube_2.description: 2 mL storage tube for dissolved DNA

steps.instrument_action: Centrifuge tube at 2000 x g for 3 minutes to pellet DNA.

steps.notes: Supernatant carefully discarded; pellet remains in tube and tube drained on absorbent paper.
5 mL of 70% ethanol added immediately; tubes inverted until pellet detached.

steps.instrument_action: Centrifuge tube at 2000 x g for 3 minutes.

steps.notes: DNA pellet air dried at room temperature for 10 minutes or until glassy.
0.5 mL for large pellet or 0.3 mL for smaller pellet; exact volume not specified in protocol.
Incubation in warming cabinet for 1 hour at 65°C to dissolve DNA.

steps.instrument_action: Shake sample overnight at room temperature to fully dissolve DNA.

steps.notes: Dissolved DNA transferred to 2 mL tube; exact volume not specified.
Sample stored at -20°C; no duration specified as this is long-term storage.
